documents.title: Certificate under SEBI (Depositories and Participants) Regulations, 2018
Quarterly Compliance Report on Corporate governance - within 21 days from the end of the quarter

analysis.summary: Management reported a strong financial performance for FY26 with significant growth in revenue, EBITDA, and PAT driven by fleet expansion and disciplined execution. The company is actively focusing on fleet expansion in the offshore and maritime segments, adding vessels like Artemis and planning further additions. While some vessels experienced temporary idle time or dry docking, management remains optimistic about long-term demand and sector opportunities. Guidance for top-line growth is estimated conservatively around 10% for the upcoming period. ABS Marine Services Limited reported its financial and operational performance for the half year and year ended March 31, 2026, highlighting growth in consolidated total income to ₹322.64 crore and net profit to ₹80.80 crore.

guidance.claim: Management expects a 10% increase in turnover from current levels in the financial year assuming all vessels run in the second half.
guidance.quote: As regards the guidance on the top line is concerned, we can expect a 10% increase -- assuming that all the vessels will be running in the second half. We can expect on the turnover front a 10% increase from the current levels.

guidance.claim: Management expects the EBITDA margin band of 45% to 50% to continue.
guidance.quote: As regards the EBITDA is concerned, I am sure that currently it is in the band of 45 to 50. I am sure that that will continue.

demand_outlook.claim: Management noted favorable demand-supply dynamics in the offshore vessel market supported by an aging global fleet and limited new vessel additions.
demand_outlook.quote: Additionally, favorable demand-supply dynamics in the offshore vessel market, supported by an aging global fleet and limited new vessel additions, continue to improve utilization levels and charter rates across segments.

demand_outlook.claim: India's maritime industry is witnessing strong momentum driven by initiatives like Maritime India Vision 2030 and support packages for shipbuilding.
demand_outlook.quote: India's maritime industry is witnessing strong momentum driven by initiatives such as the Maritime India Vision 2030, which outlines over 150 strategic initiatives with projected investments of INR3 lakh crores to INR3.5 lakh crores, along with the recently announced INR69,725 crores support package for shipbuilding.

capex_expansion.claim: During H2 FY26, the company successfully inducted the offshore support vessel Artemis into its owned fleet.
capex_expansion.quote: As part of this strategy, during H2 FY26, we successfully inducted the offshore support vessel, Artemis, into our owned fleet, expanding our vessel ownership portfolio and improving our ability to participate in higher-value offshore projects.

capex_expansion.claim: The company is scheduled to take delivery of an offshore supply vessel in Q1 FY27.
capex_expansion.quote: Further enhancing our offshore capabilities, we are also scheduled to take delivery of an offshore supply vessel in Q1 FY27.

capex_expansion.claim: The company spent a total of about $15 million for both new vessels.
capex_expansion.quote: Just a moment. We have totally, we have spent about $15 million for both the vessels.

margins_costs.claim: Consolidated total income for FY26 stood at INR322.64 crores with a robust year-on-year growth of 75.05%.
margins_costs.quote: On a consolidated basis, total income stood at INR322.64 crores, registering a robust growth of 75.05% year-on-year.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA for FY26 increased by 179.17% to INR152.55 crores and EBITDA margin expanded by 1,763 basis points to 47.28%.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA increased significantly by 179.17% to INR152.55 crores, while the EBITDA margin expanded sharply by 1,763 basis points to 47.28%.

margins_costs.claim: Profit after tax for FY26 rose by 196.45% to INR80.80 crores with a PAT margin of 25.04%.
margins_costs.quote: Profit after tax rose by 196.45% to INR80.80 crores, with a PAT margin improving by 1,026 basis points to 25.04%.

margins_costs.claim: Improved utilization levels, better margin realization, and disciplined cost management contributed to healthy growth in revenue and profitability.
margins_costs.quote: Improved utilization levels, better margin realization, and disciplined cost management have contributed to healthy growth in both revenue and profitability.

orders_capacity.claim: The company operates a diversified fleet supported by over 2,000 seafarers and shore-based professionals with offices in Mumbai, Kochi, Singapore, and Kakinada.
orders_capacity.quote: Today, we operate a diversified fleet with offices in Mumbai, Kochi, Singapore, and Kakinada, supported by over 2,000 seafarers and shore-based professionals.

orders_capacity.claim: Out of the eight owned vessels, five are on long-term charter and two have recently come out of charter.
orders_capacity.quote: Out of the eight vessels that we own, five of them are on long-term charter, three of them -- two of them have just come out of charter, and third one is just we have acquired, so it has to go into the dry dock and then only come out and then only we put her in the market.

orders_capacity.claim: Strategic contracts secured exceed ₹350 Cr in total value.
orders_capacity.quote: Over ₹350 Cr in Strategic Contracts Secured

capital_allocation.claim: Bankers are comfortable with the current debt-equity ratio for lending, and funding is not seen as a problem.
capital_allocation.quote: At this point of time with our debt-equity ratio the banks are also comfortable. I don't think we have overshot on the debt side. With adequate reserves and all, I think bankers are comfortable for lending at this point of time.

risks_headwinds.claim: Certain vessels like Emerald had to be pulled out for upcoming dry docking.
risks_headwinds.quote: Whereas Emerald, we had to pull out because the dry docking was coming up, so some jobs were to be done.

management_commitments.claim: Management stated a continued commitment to building a robust asset base that drives operational efficiency, enhances service delivery, and supports sustainable long-term growth.
management_commitments.quote: We stay committed to building a robust asset base that drives operational efficiency, enhances service delivery, and supports sustainable long-term growth.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
